hypothesis: On 72 fresh banks with prespecified correlated repeat corruption, both an explicitly supplied correlated-channel likelihood and the unchanged H1ce estimated-IID method recover at least 60/72 exact graphs. The unchanged method loses on at most 2/72 banks solved by the supplied model. Assess all three endpoints separately and retain both-arm uncertainty conservatively.
why_this_boundary: H1cf and H1cg changed scalar rates between banks and across cells while preserving conditional independence of repeated query errors. H1ch breaks that independence at each observed position: half the time all three responses share one corruption event. Agreement then overstates independent evidence, and H1ce's disagreement inversion estimates a smaller apparent rate. A supplied joint-likelihood control can discount unanimous responses without receiving which positions used the shared branch. This tests a distinct structural assumption, not another nearby rate sweep.
fixed_strength: Nominal marginal corruption p=3/40 and shared-branch probability rho=1/2. These values are selected prospectively as a simple, substantial correlation intervention, with no cohort pilots, strength probes or outcome-based selection. Every individual query still has the same nominal marginal error rate as the earlier homogeneous source; only repeat dependence changes.
scope: 72 new 90-row official-source banks; all outcomes retained. Freshness is relative to the declared combined Ripper/H4ak ledger through H1cg, not universal repository untouchedness. No tuning, retries, extensions, bank replacement or hidden subgroup selection. Preserve reserved and unrelated work.
source: Exclusions are H1cg archived exclusions union all H1cg selected IDs. Sample 90 official IDs without replacement within each bank from the eligible pool; retain all cross-bank repeats. Seal all IDs and masks before selected CSV labels; independently check CSV correspondence and update ledgers even if later scoring or inference fails.
mask: One fresh GF(9) affine-line-complement cycle per bank: 90 rows, 72 queried cells per row, 80 observed rows per cell, 71 coqueries per pair. All three query slots share this mask, and both methods share the identical triple-response record.
acquisition: For each bank, an independent shared-branch stream draws one 90x81 binary64 uniform array, with Z=(uniform<1/2). Separately, each of first/repeat1/repeat2 draws a 90x81 binary64 uniform array followed by a 90x81 int8 offset array in 1..8. Each stream's potential noisy label corrupts iff its uniform<float(3/40), adding its offset modulo 9. The first response always uses the first stream. At Z=true, both later responses reuse that same noisy label; at Z=false, they use their respective independent streams. Z is independent across source-instance/cell positions and independent of all corruption streams. Retain all potential streams and Z uniforms for provenance, including unused repeat potentials. Only masked acquired responses enter either scorer.
finite_generator_law: rho=1/2 is represented exactly, with binary64 threshold hex 0x1.0000000000000p-1 and exactly 2^52 of 2^53 uniform outcomes below it. For p=3/40, freeze threshold hex and actual event probability ceil(float(3/40)*2^53)/2^53 as before. The supplied arm receives nominal rational p and rho; do not claim this is exactly the tiny finite-generator marginal probability. Distinct seeds do not prove PRNG independence.
information_boundary: The supplied_correlated arm receives only observed triples, mask, and the fixed nominal parameters p=3/40 and rho=1/2. It does NOT receive Z, raw uniforms/offsets, potential unused labels, clean labels or graph truth. It marginalizes the unobserved shared branch. The estimated_iid arm receives only observed triples and mask, calling immutable H1ce estimate/scorer/reference with no p, rho or branch argument. This is an explicit model-information advantage for the control, not an equal-information algorithm ranking or a causal separation of channel estimation from dependence modeling.
supplied_math: Let p=a/b, K=8b, and u_q(d)=8*(b-a) when observed query y_q equals candidate digit d, otherwise a. For rho=r/s, the exact integer joint likelihood for three responses is W(d)=r*I[y1=y2=y3]*u_1(d)*K^2+(s-r)*product_q u_q(d), with common denominator s*K^3 omitted. Here a=3,b=40,r=1,s=2. Normalize the nine W(d). For each coobserved pair, posterior equality is the dot product of the two normalized cell distributions. Use unchanged pair composite -log(1-equality), summed across coobservations and half-even quantized at 1e6. For nonunanimous observations the shared branch has zero likelihood; for unanimous observations both latent branches contribute. Do not expose the realized branch to the control. This is a pair composite objective, not full graph maximum likelihood.
estimated_iid_math: Use immutable H1ce estimator and independent reference on all 19440 repeated-label pair comparisons, exact f(p)=2p-9p^2/8 inversion, fixed 1..88% grid, half-even rounding, explicit clipping and no-data/admissibility rules. Then use its unchanged IID posterior composite likelihood. Under the nominal correlated model E[D/T]=(1-rho)*f(p)=1839/25600, rather than f(3/40)=1839/12800. The apparent scalar target is f^{-1}(1839/25600); report this diagnostic without retuning. The same data estimate and score, so no independence or unbiasedness claim is made.
numerics: Retain immutable 80/160-digit outward producer logarithm intervals and independent 200-digit, 240-term rational-product reference bounds. The new supplied posterior implementation must independently verify the exact joint mixture formula and every unique observation-pattern pair type. Check integer overflow bounds with Python integers before any fixed-width operation. An uncertified cost skips its whole arm; no zero placeholder reaches a solver. Existing frozen math and ancestor packages stay unchanged.
inference: 144 new complete degree1..40 grids and 144 analytic degree-zero witnesses. Exact curvature over1..39 with lower-degree ties; true degree20 and edge count810 withheld from selection. Reuse unchanged single-thread HiGHS settings and literal half-integral certificates. Finish both bank grids before truth diagnostics. Selected fractional is resolved failure; inadmissible estimate, uncertified cost or required grid makes the arm unresolved. No retries, omitted banks or post-fit selection.

primary.supplied_exact: At least60/72: lower=known supplied exact, upper adds supplied unresolved; support lower>=60, falsify upper<60, otherwise inconclusive.
primary.iid_exact: At least60/72: lower=known unchanged-method exact, upper adds its unresolved; support lower>=60, falsify upper<60, otherwise inconclusive.
primary.paired_regressions: At most2/72 pairs where supplied exact and unchanged method nonexact. Lower counts known supplied exact with resolved unchanged-method failure. Upper includes every pair possibly supplied exact and possibly unchanged-method nonexact, including uncertainty on either arm. Support upper<=2, falsify lower>2, otherwise inconclusive.

diagnostics: All bank outcomes, estimated rate bins/clipping and disagreement calibration; selected degrees/ties, fixed20/top810 diagnostic recovery, paired gains/losses, literal selected-primal differences and exact truth gaps. Also retain Z branch counts, per-query marginal errors, pair disagreements and unanimous-response rates as post-fit diagnostics. Z never becomes a model feature or a filtered endpoint. Report all source repeats, query identities, integer/numerical proofs, timing and utilization. Different objective scales do not yield directly comparable gap effect sizes; optimality does not imply uniqueness.
controls: Fresh supplied joint-channel inference is the primary paired control, with its parameter-information advantage explicit. H1cf/H1cg are historical context only and their banks are excluded; do not pool denominators. BP AdamW appears first in comparisons and is outside this structural inference study. No new neural fit or fresh measurement claim for published baseline numbers.
seed_rule: Acquisition base+bank0..71, including a separate shared-branch stream. Actual solver=base+41*(2*bank+arm)+degree. 432 acquisition and5760 solver seeds. Scan current explicit frozen seed fields and expand recent Ripper acquisition/solver formulas plus declared root study ranges before freeze; distinguish this audit from universal PRNG independence. Avoid prospective H4bc bases202613700000..202613740000.
budget_scope: ID/mask sealing, source materialization/independent CSV audit, correlated-query acquisition and independent reconstruction/global seal, all144 grids, exact numerical/estimate/proof/endpoint/accounting audits, monitoring and export. Gates/registration and publication replays separately timed. No extensions or retries; any ceiling failure remains incomplete with retained artifacts.

query_accounting.reuse: Both methods reuse all three physical query identities at each observed position. Shared latent corruption can return identical values, but those remain three acquired responses; do not relabel them as one cheaper acquisition. Unused potential noise variates are latent simulation records, not additional acquired labels or oracle accesses.
query_accounting.clean_unique_formula: 81*new unique official IDs, reusing source values across repeated instances.

gates: Independent joint-likelihood review before freeze. Enumerate all729 triple patterns and all nine candidate truths; verify Fraction mixture probabilities, normalization, all-same versus nonunanimous branches, rho0 equivalence to immutable IID scorer and rho1 repeated-response behavior on synthetic support only. At rho1 impossible nonunanimous observations must be explicitly rejected, not normalized from zero. Certify every unique rho1/2 pair type with the independent rational-log method; full-shape unrelated synthetic cost/reference parity, digit permutation and cell swaps. Exercise 80/160 rounding, all numerical/invalid-estimator no-call cases, dtype/range/overflow guards, exact branch/event thresholds, first/noise/repeat stream order, branch-blind scorer interfaces, complete-label substitution, full72-bank synthetic lifecycle, all16paired uncertainty combinations, endpoint cases, certificate mutations and runner/seed bindings. No cohort or strength pilots.
optimization: Use eight persistent workers and cache only data-independent mixture type tables. Reuse one independently certified cost reference within each charged bank audit as in H1cg. Measure source/acquisition and numerical/certificate costs on unrelated fixed synthetic fixtures; log live CPU, LP and audit progress. Preserve full query/model evidence and frozen comparability. No eligible GPU implementation exists for this exact LP/rational pipeline.
interpretation: This isolates a new acquisition-family boundary while acknowledging the control's extra model knowledge. It does not establish a practical estimator of unknown correlation, asymmetric-channel robustness, a general causal mechanism or CRAM puzzle-search accuracy. Shared latent branches are a specified synthetic corruption process, not a statement about the real dataset's measurement mechanism.
review: Design only. No implementation, new cohort ID/mask/branch/noise draws, estimate, score or LP has been executed. Await design review and then complete independently reviewed source/gates before freeze.
